newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stockholm exchange in talks with Nordic bourses.
newsitem.headline: Stockholm exchange in talks with Nordic bourses.

text.p: The Stockholm Stock Exchange said on Friday it was in talks with other Nordic bourses about cooperation in addition to ongoing discussions with derivatives exchange OM.

"It would be natural if the Nordic bourses -- which each are small but together would create a market significantly attractive in Europe -- cooperated in ways which would make integration of trade and marketing possible," Stockholm Stock Exchange head Bengt Ryden said in a statement.
